title: ZTO-Agent task specification (R1)
description: The JSON task spec the ZTO-Agent must produce. Expressive: it can state what the operator asked even when the testbed cannot actuate it (op "<=", target center_ues, "unspecified"); zto/actuatable.json lists what can be deployed and gate check 0 enforces it. Every numeric bound lives in this file only.

horizon_ms.description: Prediction horizon H (label evaluated at t + H). 0 = detection.

label_rule.description: Congestion definition (zto/catalog/label_rule.yaml): feature op threshold_pct sustained for min_duration_s. The persistence baseline applies the same rule at t.

op.description: What the operator asked; actuatable: ">=" only (zto/actuatable.json). "unspecified" resolves to the default.

slice_action.description: PRB reservation via FlexRIC SLICE SM (zto/catalog/slice_actions.yaml); replaces the brief's rc_action — this control path is not E2SM-RC.

target.description: Who the operator wants protected. Actuatable: protected_ue only (the xApp always protects UE3, zto/actuatable.json). No default: "unspecified" → gate HOLD (beneficiary not stated).

debounce_n.description: ML policy acts after debounce_n consecutive positive predictions. Default ceil(1000 / sampling_ms) (~1 s), so the 1-2 s post-idle MCS spike cannot trigger it.
